info.title: GoSystem TBB API
info.description:
A RESTful API to provide access to the GoSystem TBB functionality.

Get Locator API (/v1/trialbalance/locators/{account}/{year}) - Retrieves the list of locators along with the binder ID.

GET Template API (/v1/trialBalance/{binderid}/importTemplates/{importtype}) - Retrieves the list of templates available for the particular import type. The import types are 3000 - Preliminary Balances, 3001 - Adjustments, 3 - TCC, 3007 - Schedule M-3. You can pass the binder IDs you get from the Get Locator API.

TBB Import (/v1/trialBalance/{binderid}/import/{importtype}/template/{templateid}) - Imports the data from Excel in Preliminary Balance, Adjustment, Schedule M-3, and TCC screens. Import type IDs for different imports are 3000 - Preliminary Balances, 3001 - Adjustments, 3 - TCC, 3007 - Schedule M-3. You'll get the template ID from the GET Template API.

Valid tax return types are 1120C, 1120S, and 1065 for TBB Import. Trial Balance Computation API (/v1/trialBalance/{binderId}/computations) - Submits a batch job to the compute queue. Once the batch job is completed successfully, the data from the Trial Balance bridge is updated in the organizer.
Note: Make sure the locator is closed while performing this operation. Compute Transfer Options API (/v1/trialBalance/{binderId}/compute-transfer-config) - This endpoint allows you to update the computed date within the organizer. To ensure that the organizer is updated, the parameter UpdateFederalTAS must be set to true. If UpdateFederalTAS is set to false, the data is updated only within the TBB and isn't transferred to the organizer. Compute Status API (/v1/trialBalance/{binderId}/compute-status) - Retrieves combined compute information for a binder. This includes Compute Status, Compute Options, and Compute Process Options.

get.summary: Retrieve the list of locators along with binder ID
get.operationId: List of locators along with Binder ID

parameters.name: account
parameters.description: A 4-digit alphanumeric identifier representing the client account. This must match the Account value provided in the request headers.

parameters.name: year
parameters.description: The tax year for which the e-file is being created. Must be a valid 4-digit year (for example, 2024).

200.description: Success. The locator list is retrieved.

get.summary: Retrieve the list of templates for import type

parameters.name: binderid
parameters.description: A Binder ID is a unique alphanumeric identifier for a trial balance binder in GoSystem Tax RS. To retrieve Binder IDs for a specific account and tax year, you can use the endpoint GET /v1/trialbalance/locators/{account}/{year}.

parameters.name: importtype
parameters.description: Identifies the category of data being imported into a Trial Balance Binder. Available types are 3000 – Preliminary Balances, 3001 – Adjustments, 3 – TCC, and 3007 – Schedule M-3.

200.description: Success. The template list is retrieved.

post.summary: Import data from Excel into TBB screens
post.description: Import the data from excel in Prelim. Balance, Adjustment, Schedule M3  and TCC Screen. Import Type id for different imports > Prelim. Balance-3000 Adjustment- 3001 Schedule M3- 3007 TCC- 3. The Trial Balance Browser (TBB) must be launched on the same locator where the import is performed. Failure to do so may result in import issues.

get.summary: Get combined compute information for a binder
get.description:
Retrieves combined compute information for a binder. This includes Compute Status, Compute Options, and Compute Process Options.

**Compute Status Codes:**  
- -21: An Exchange Rate Chart is assigned, but the Translation Gain/Loss account isn't assigned.  
- -20: An Exchange Rate Chart isn't assigned.  
- -15: ONESOURCE State Apportionment connection error.  
- -14: Unable to consolidate binder.  
- -12: Internal error: Invalid Batch ID.  
- -7: Compute Never Finished. Retry.  
- -4: Warning: Database errors have occurred. Check Action Items for possible sources of this error. If this warning persists, contact customer support.  
- 0: Compute Initializing...  
- 1: Compute Error. Check Action Items for possible sources of this error.  
- 2: Compute Shutting Down...  
- 3: Compute server not found.  
- 4: Compute Ready  
- 5: TAS Compute finished. Determining Organizer Transfer settings  
- 6: Compute Queued...  
- 7: Compute Started...  
- 9: TAS Computing...  
- 10: Organizer Computing...  
- 15: History Refreshing...  
- 16: Updating Entity Information...  
- 17: Transferring Federal Data to Organizer...  
- 18: Transferring State Data to Organizer...  
- 19: Transferring Provision Data to Organizer...  
- 21: Transferring International Data to Organizer...  
- 22: Opening Organizer Database...  
- 23: Transferring Federal Data from Organizer...  
- 24: Transferring State Data from Organizer...  
- 25: Closing Organizer Database...  
- 27: Domestic Compute Complete...  
- 28: Translation gain/loss account not assigned.  
- 30: Transferring BNA data to organizer...  
- 31: BNA Import Complete  
- 32: Retrieving ONESOURCE State Apportionment Data...
